headline: Altair Plastics reports minor shipment delays at Windsor plant
body: Altair Plastics confirmed shipment delays of several days at its Windsor plant due to a equipment maintenance backlog. The company said deliveries should normalize within weeks.

headline: Altair Plastics opens new production line in Windsor
body: Altair Plastics commissioned a new line at its Windsor site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Altair Plastics wins quality award from industry association
body: Altair Plastics received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Altair Plastics appoints new regional sales director
body: Altair Plastics announced a leadership appointment in its sales organization. The company said the change is part of a planned succession.

headline: Altair Plastics announces layoffs affecting 6% of workforce
body: Altair Plastics said it will cut 6% of its workforce as part of a cost reduction program. Unions criticized the lack of consultation.

headline: Altair Plastics signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Altair Plastics announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.
